sourceRef.title: Using ChatGPT to Draw Sequence Diagram

sentences.text: To use ChatGPT to generate a sequence diagram, you can provide a description of the system and the interactions between its components.

sourceRef.title: Using ChatGPT to Draw Sequence Diagram

sentences.text: The description should be written in a clear and concise manner, using plain language and logical ordering of events.

sourceRef.title: Using ChatGPT to Draw Sequence Diagram

sentences.text: Once you have the description, you can use a tool like Mermaid to create the diagram.

sourceRef.title: Using ChatGPT to Draw Sequence Diagram

sentences.text: In the following example using ChatGPT 3.5 Turbo, we have described the process of a user withdrawing cash from an ATM using their bank's mobile app.

sourceRef.title: Using ChatGPT to Draw Sequence Diagram

sentences.text: We have requested that a sequence diagram be generated using Mermaid syntax.

sourceRef.title: Using ChatGPT to Draw Sequence Diagram

sentences.text: We refined the prompt approximately 10 times to ensure the best possible result.

sentences.text: ChatGPT generates natural language descriptions of a given prompt, which can be helpful for reviewing whether the prompt is clear and understandable to the model.

sourceRef.title: Using ChatGPT to Draw Sequence Diagram

sentences.text: Below is the script generated by ChatGPT.

sourceRef.title: Using ChatGPT to Draw Sequence Diagram

sentences.text: In this diagram, each participant is represented as a vertical line.

sourceRef.title: Using ChatGPT to Draw Sequence Diagram

sentences.text: The arrows indicate the flow of messages between the participants.↵The journey starts with the user pressing the 'Withdraw Cash from ATM' button in the bank app and inputting the amount of cash to withdraw.

sourceRef.title: Using ChatGPT to Draw Sequence Diagram

sentences.text: The user then presses the 'Start to Withdraw' button, which activates the camera in the bank app.↵The user then presses a button on the ATM to show the mobile withdraw QR code.

sourceRef.title: Using ChatGPT to Draw Sequence Diagram

sentences.text: The ATM calls the Withdraw Token API to request a mobile withdraw token, which is stored in the database and sent back to the ATM.↵The ATM generates a QR code from the token and presents it on the ATM screen.

sourceRef.title: Using ChatGPT to Draw Sequence Diagram

sentences.text: The bank app scans the QR code and sends the token and withdraw amount to the Withdraw Request API.↵The Withdraw Request API checks if the token exists in the database and if it is expired.

sourceRef.title: Using ChatGPT to Draw Sequence Diagram

sentences.text: If the token exists and is not expired, the Withdraw Request API invalidates the token in the database and commits the transaction with the token from the Transaction API.

sourceRef.title: Using ChatGPT to Draw Sequence Diagram

sentences.text: The Transaction API updates the transaction status to the database.↵The ATM polls the Transaction Status API to check for transaction completion, and the Transaction Status API checks the transaction status from the database and returns it to the ATM.

sourceRef.title: Using ChatGPT to Draw Sequence Diagram

sentences.text: Once the transaction is completed, the ATM presents the cash to the user.↵Finally, the user picks up the cash from the ATM, completing the withdrawal process.

sourceRef.title: Using ChatGPT to Draw Sequence Diagram

sentences.text: If the token does not exist or is expired, the bank app shows an invalid QR code message to the user.
